# BotBarConnector

## Purpose
The bar's own Connector: `BotBarScreenConnectorSubContext` carries the System's announcements to
its screen and the screen's tap back, listed on `BotBarConnectorRoot`, a child of
`BotBarSystemRoot`. The game's tab-to-page wiring is the game's `BotBarConnectorSubContext`, in
its ConnectorModule.

## Concepts
bot bar connector, BotBarScreenConnectorSubContext, BotBarConnectorRoot
